# cato_secondary_aws_vsocket (Resource)

Manages the secondary AWS vSocket configuration on an existing compatible AWS site. Does not provision AWS infrastructure. Route table changes update the site's shared route table configuration. Import using the secondary socket ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure an existing AWS vSocket site with an unused secondary slot.
# Provision the AWS ENI, instance and route table separately.
resource "cato_secondary_aws_vsocket" "example" {
  site = {
    id = "12345"
    # name = "AWS branch" # Use name instead of id if preferred.
  }
  eni_ip_address = "10.20.1.10"
  eni_ip_subnet  = "10.20.1.0/24"
  # This table is shared by the site's socket connection configuration.
  route_table_id = "rtb-example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `eni_ip_address` (String) Secondary ENI IPv4 address within eni_ip_subnet.
- `eni_ip_subnet` (String) Canonical IPv4 network prefix for the secondary ENI.
- `route_table_id` (String) AWS route table ID, shared by the site's socket connection configuration.
- `site` (Attributes) Parent AWS site. Changes require replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Secondary socket ID

### Nested Schema for `site`

Optional:

- `id` (String) Site ID
- `name` (String) Site name
